oauth2_authorize.description:
Click 'Confirm' to authorize Home Assistant to access your Navimow account.

You will be redirected to the Navimow login page to complete authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication Required
reauth_confirm.description: Your Navimow authentication has expired. Please re-authenticate to continue using the integration.

private_login.title: Complete Navimow setup
private_login.description: Enable automatic LiDAR maps, zones, telemetry and advanced controls. Your password is used only to obtain renewable tokens and is not stored.

rain_forecast.name: Rain pause based on weather forecast

set_zone_name.name: Set zone name
set_zone_name.description: Register a known partition ID or assign it a friendly name.

mower_id.name: Mower ID
mower_id.description: Required only when more than one mower is configured. Accepts its cloud ID, serial number, or name.

partition_id.name: Partition ID
partition_id.description: The exact numeric partition previously shown by the Target zone or Current mowing zone sensor.

name.name: Friendly zone name
name.description: The name displayed by the Prepared mowing zone selector.

start_prepared_zone_experimental.name: Start prepared zone (experimental)
start_prepared_zone_experimental.description: Sends exactly one experimental official smart-home command. The server may ignore the selected zone and mow all zones.

mower_id.name: Mower ID
mower_id.description: Required only when more than one mower is configured. Accepts its cloud ID, serial number, or name.

confirm_all_zone_risk.name: I accept the all-zone start risk
confirm_all_zone_risk.description: Required confirmation that Navimow may ignore the prepared zone and start mowing the entire map.

mow.name: Mow selected zones
mow.description: Start mowing one or more map zones in the exact order supplied. Can restart from scratch or continue existing progress.

device_id.name: Mower
device_id.description: Optional when only one mower is configured.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Numeric partition IDs in the desired mowing order.

reset.name: Restart from scratch
reset.description: When enabled, clear previous mowing progress and start a fresh trail. Disable to continue the remaining uncut area.

set_schedule.name: Set mowing schedule
set_schedule.description: Save one weekday's mowing periods and selected zones.

device_id.name: Mower
device_id.description: Optional when only one mower is configured.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: List of start/end times and optional numeric zone IDs. The scheduler card builds this automatically.
